description: This file contains utility functions for the Slap Object Wrapper (Obj Wrapper) in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) implementation. The primary function shown is SlapCreateObjWrapper, which creates and returns a new Obj Wrapper object by calling SlapOwoCreate with provided context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapCreateObjWrapper(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates a new Slap Obj Wrapper object using the provided context handles.
